LanguageData.Mech_CentipedeMRL.label: MRL centipede
LanguageData.Mech_CentipedeMRL.description: Heavy combat mechanoids that glide on dozens of tiny legs. Their thick carapace and firepower makes them very effective against bunched-up static defenders，This type of centipede uses lighter armor and a dual mounted infantry magnetic rail weapon system, resulting in faster movement speed, but correspondingly, its resistance to attacks is also weakened.
